items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: When I was in the band I was just a youngster... Those were the elders in the band, see.

ctx.x: Well ladies and gentlemen, if you ever run into John Heard, you’ve got to ask— ©Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
Yeah, call Buddy Tate back in. He knows it. Those were the elders in the band, see. When I was in the band I was just a youngster so I can’t do that.
Well Al told us quite a story about when he was the new guy and they really, you know, gave him some initiation. Was that the same with you?
